3.4.2.summary: View Australian radar, track 2-5 km updraft helicity, read OpenStreetMap roads and load weather overlays with less processing time.

highlights.title: 2-5 km updraft helicity
highlights.description: Replace the updraft-velocity entry with 1-hour maximum updraft helicity for the 2-5 km AGL layer on HRRR and other models that publish the hourly field. Both 1-hour and 3-hour products share the supplied stepped 0-400 m²/s² colour scale.

highlights.title: Three-hour updraft tracks
highlights.description: View the maximum across three consecutive hourly fields from the same model run. This product starts at forecast hour 3 and requires the complete interval. Load Hours and cache counts use only the supported hours.

highlights.title: Australian radar and faster display
highlights.description: Find 67 Australian radar sites by name or ID in Live Tracking and view Base Reflectivity and Doppler Velocity from the MRRL feed at the lowest available elevation. Velocity uses your existing colour table and unit preferences, with range folding distinct from missing coverage. Actual scan times remain visible. Radar images take less processing time to display, keeping their colours and hover values. US velocity tilt checks load separately and reuse recent scan listings; connection problems remain distinct from missing scans.

highlights.title: More responsive live overlays
highlights.description: Load independent warning sources together and process storm reports and nearby surface observations with less overhead. Storm-report legends show full hazard names and distinguish significant hail and wind reports. Surface stations share the same clear temperature, dewpoint and wind styling; older reports use a small neutral dashed ring and retain the time warning on hover. GOES downloads reuse connections and can cancel pending requests while preserving the selected scan time. Official colours, units, actual observation times and missing-wind states stay intact; incomplete updates remain distinct from an all-clear or calm observation.

highlights.title: More responsive forecast maps
highlights.description: Forecast contours, wind barbs and terrain-relative lapse-rate and shear maps take less time to prepare, preserving their geometry, true-north directions and missing-data gaps. Toggle OpenStreetMap roads and road names under Layers → Map details, with muted outlines in dark mode and a saved choice for each panel. Model map downloads reuse connections and retain retries, byte limits and cancellation. ECMWF map inventories also take less time to process while retaining field levels and precipitation intervals.

highlights.title: Faster startup and sounding preparation
highlights.description: Open workspaces when needed and keep the map ready after its first visit. Locator borders reuse prepared paths, while wind layers, convective temperatures, parcels, Storm Slinky and analogue searches share calculations. Ensemble requests fetch independent members together while keeping each member's order and failure details. Forecast downloads check compatible sources with less overhead and keep source failover. IEM downloads reuse connections and retain the requested station and time; IGRA decoding preserves units, source information and missing-data checks. Sounding sources, controls and the frame around the chart use the workspace's glass, with rounded hovers and compact Height chart and Diagnostic panel dropdowns. Choose sounding models, runs, forecast hours and observed launch times in compact glass popups beside the sidebar, with model search and UTC hour tiles. Helper text, placeholders and profile details stay readable over bright maps. Choose All height charts or switch directly to one chart or diagnostic, without checkmarks or radio buttons. Profile and parcel controls sit above, with a separate export section below. Edit one pressure level at a time, switch variables and step through adjacent levels. Invalid values show a short range message. The sidebar drops the extra Info panel; select profiles in multi-time files from Sounding controls. The Settings sidebar drops its introductory subtitle. Unit controls show symbols and a brief chart-units note.

3.4.1.summary: SPC outlooks follow the selected forecast time, clear outdated risk areas and refresh every five minutes.

highlights.title: Current outlooks for the selected time
highlights.description: Changing the selected hour loads its own outlook issuance. Current Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3 forecasts are checked by their valid windows, including morning issuances before 12Z.

highlights.title: Respect outlooks with no plotted risk areas
highlights.description: Valid outlooks with no plotted risk areas clear older polygons instead of bringing back an earlier forecast.

highlights.title: Five-minute refresh and recovery
highlights.description: Enabled SPC layers refresh every five minutes in Model Viewer. Missing recent products are retried within five minutes, so a temporary gap does not hide an outlook for six hours.

3.1.0.summary: Live weather joins forecasts and soundings in one workspace.

highlights.title: Live Tracking
highlights.description: Follow radar, satellite imagery, surface observations, warnings and watches. Replay the past hour where the source provides history.

highlights.title: More radar detail
highlights.description: Explore high-resolution Base Reflectivity, Velocity, Correlation Coefficient and Enhanced Echo Tops, with verified tilts and values on hover.

highlights.title: Your panels, your setup
highlights.description: Use up to four synchronized panels. Layers, map projection, playback and display preferences are remembered on this device.

highlights.title: Clearer downloads and storage
highlights.description: Load forecast hours before playback and manage forecast and live-weather caches separately in Settings.

highlights.title: Safer sounding edits
highlights.description: Closing a sounding with local changes asks before discarding your edits and undo history.

3.2.0.summary: A faster workspace with clearer downloads and more reliable caching.

highlights.title: Faster maps and soundings
highlights.description: Upcoming forecast images are prepared before playback advances. Repeated sounding requests reuse downloaded model data and prepared rendering work.

highlights.title: More control over downloads
highlights.description: See which forecast hours are saved and which are ready to play. Check the cache, retry missing hours, or stop a model-sounding download. Stopped downloads no longer block new requests.

highlights.title: More reliable caching
highlights.description: Forecast caches have size and age limits. Active downloads stay protected, and failed sounding downloads clean up their temporary files.

highlights.title: A simpler Overview
highlights.description: Start with Model Viewer, Live Tracking or Soundings. Model availability and recent activity stay close at hand in expandable rows.

highlights.title: Release highlights in the app
highlights.description: See a short What’s new popup after a version change, and revisit the highlights anytime in Settings → Updates.

3.2.1.summary: More reliable maps and soundings, with clearer recovery and safer saved settings.

highlights.title: More reliable forecast changes
highlights.description: Forecast changes recover while older requests stop. Shared downloads keep running for panels that need them; leaving Model Viewer pauses automatic preloading. Failed downloads stop their remaining transfers, and provider failures report their original cause.

highlights.title: Release unused rendering memory
highlights.description: Switching between globe and flat maps releases unused graphics resources. Completed and failed sounding renders release unused image buffers before the next request. Scientific values, profile edits and lossless HD and UHD exports keep their existing quality.

highlights.title: Every sounding time
highlights.description: Choose any time in an imported forecast file. Each time keeps its own edits and undo history, and exported charts use the selected profile. Typed station IDs survive source-tab changes.

highlights.title: Clearer Map Controls And Recovery
highlights.description: Controls use orange hover feedback throughout both themes. Maps remove the heavy road network for clearer weather and labels. Manage forecast downloads in one panel with animated hour lists; the Fast/Smooth icon sits beside Loop. Drawn maps stay available through recoverable rendering errors. Retry failed maps, imagery and overlays. Pan with arrow keys and press Enter to inspect the map’s centre.

highlights.title: Settings stay usable
highlights.description: If device storage is unavailable or full, workspace settings keep working for the current session. Long release highlights scroll with their close controls in reach. Unchanged map labels reuse their layout during forecast playback.

highlights.title: Updated bundled security components
highlights.description: The Windows app includes a maintained Python and TLS runtime, updated libraries for network access and weather files, and signed installer checks. Downloads include checksums and a detailed component inventory.

3.4.0.summary: More global and regional forecast maps, clearer sounding controls and safer app updates.

highlights.title: More forecast choices
highlights.description: Browse CONUS, Global and Regional models with more supported GFS, ECMWF, NAM and HRW fields. Open ECMWF 9km and GDPS soundings, or explore AIGFS maps. Unavailable parameters stay hidden; AIGFS is maps only.

highlights.title: Copy a useful diagnostic
highlights.description: Copy a failed operation's provider, time, error category and recovery action from Logs. Credentials, raw errors and request details stay out.

highlights.title: Understand graphics quality
highlights.description: Compare Automatic, Low, Balanced and High in one view. See the active profile and when Automatic reduces rendering quality.

highlights.title: Clearer sounding readouts
highlights.description: Read glass tooltips in both themes, edit levels in a compact sidebar and export annotations in your chosen units. Failed recalculations keep your chart and pending edit.

highlights.title: Clearer controls
highlights.description: Find parameters with readable search and separate descriptions. Navigate without hover readouts, retry from clear popups and browse hours while downloads continue. Saved maps reopen offline.

highlights.title: Review work before updating
highlights.description: Review work before installing. Preferences and disk caches stay; open soundings, edits and history are lost. New or unfinished edits trigger another review, and failed preference saves stop installation. Exported PNGs cannot restore editable work.

3.3.0.summary: Clearer forecast and radar playback, larger sounding views, and simpler map controls.

highlights.title: Forecast hours and radar scans
highlights.description: Forecast hours show green outlines for cached images, blue for downloads and red for failures, with direct retries. Radar scans has a matching movable picker before Site Tilt, distinguishing available, loading, missing, delayed and failed frames while keeping playback compact.

highlights.title: Simpler map controls
highlights.description: Manage layer order, visibility and legends in a centered, movable glass popup. Opacity and provider options appear inside each layer’s settings. Search stations or radar sites in a larger popup; radar-site selection is available only in Live Tracking. Lighter hover cards and centered recovery notices keep the map readable.

highlights.title: Keep your place
highlights.description: Keep the exact map position, zoom, selected point and inspector state when changing models, parameters, panel layouts or workspaces, including changes made immediately after moving the map.

highlights.title: More room for sounding inspection
highlights.description: Swap the sidebar between sources and controls to give the chart more room. Inspect linked Skew-T and hodograph levels with separate transparent readouts, including levels above the visible hodograph trace. Compare original and edited values, identify edited levels and jump through undo history. Display all four height charts together.

highlights.title: Clear requests and exports
highlights.description: Check coordinate ranges and model coverage before requesting a sounding. Follow download, decoding, calculation and rendering stages, and cancel with your inputs and open profiles retained. HD/UHD exports show PNG size, dimensions and a reliable ready state; unchanged images reuse completed renders.

highlights.title: Updates and maintenance
highlights.description: Automatic update checks run once per UTC window starting at 00:00 and 12:00, remembered across restarts. Missed checks catch up when the app is open and online; manual checks remain available anytime. Weather-file, image, certificate, native and build dependencies are updated. The README has a simple download-history graph built from measured application-package counts.
